groups.rationale: Run 23988c96 showed guest-lifecycle cycles stopping at compute_catalog_unavailable because request-scoped operator Marshall evaluations crashed on a cold TLS pool under injected latency, and a lost final stop left the slot occupied; 17-reference records the harness-only operator pool budgets, idempotent retries and same-key stop resubmission. Production Repo configuration and Marshall nodes are unchanged; no native evidence is claimed.
